decoration: moderate — a few SVG blobs or grid lines
hero_layout: stacked cinematic — big fullscreen text with scroll cue
hero_headline_scale: subtle — standard h1 size, nothing crazy
hero_height: auto — natural content height, no forced height
nav_style: bottom bar — fixed navigation at the bottom
scroll_animation: playful — elements slide/bounce in from different directions
image_treatment: no clip — square with heavy shadow
spacing_density: ultra-spacious — luxury feel, huge gaps between sections
quirk: project cards are arranged in a diagonal / staggered grid
bonus_quirk: footer includes a tiny randomly chosen emoji that changes daily
